1.h: Added Articles 31A and 31B and the Ninth Schedule to protect certain laws, added to Article 15, and replaced Article 19(2).

3.h: Replaced entry 33 in the Seventh Schedule, which lists Union, State and Concurrent subjects.

4.h: Replaced Article 31A(1) and Article 305, and added entries 14 to 20 to the Ninth Schedule.

5.h: Replaced the proviso to Article 3 on forming new States and changing State boundaries.

6.h: Changed rules on taxing sales of goods: added to Article 269, replaced parts of Article 286, and added Seventh Schedule entries.

7.h: Reorganised the States: removed Part A, B and C categories, replaced Articles 81, 82, 170, 239 and 240, and added Articles 258A and 290A.

9.h: Added to the First Schedule, which lists the States and Union territories and their areas.

10.h: Added Dadra and Nagar Haveli as a Union territory in the First Schedule and under Article 240.

11.h: Changed how the Vice-President is elected, replacing the joint meeting of both Houses of Parliament in Article 66.

13.h: Added Article 371A with special provisions for Nagaland and renamed Part XXI to cover special provisions.

14.h: Added Article 239A for local legislatures or Councils of Ministers in Union territories, and added to Article 240 and the First Schedule.

15.h: Changed High Court judges' retirement age in Article 217, added Article 224A on retired judges, and changed Articles 124, 222, 311, 316.

16.h: Added to Article 19, changed qualifications for MPs and MLAs in Articles 84 and 173, and updated oath forms in the Third Schedule.

17.h: Added to and replaced part of Article 31A, and added entries 21 to 64 to the Ninth Schedule.

18.h: Added to Article 3 on forming new States and changing State boundaries.

19.h: Removed election tribunals from the Election Commission's powers in Article 324.

20.h: Added Article 233A, validating the appointments and judgments of certain district judges.

21.h: Added to the list of languages in the Eighth Schedule.

22.h: Added Article 244A allowing an autonomous State for tribal areas in Assam, Article 371B for Assam, and a change to Article 275.

23.h: Changed how Anglo-Indian members are nominated to State Legislative Assemblies under Article 333.

24.h: Retitled Article 368 to cover Parliament's power to amend the Constitution, and added clauses to Articles 13 and 368.

25.h: Added Article 31C, protecting laws that give effect to certain Directive Principles.

26.h: Removed privy purses and Rulers' privileges (Articles 291 and 362) and added Article 363A ending recognition of Rulers of Indian States.

27.h: Added Article 371C for Manipur and Article 239B on Ordinances by Union territory administrators, and changed Article 240.

28.h: Added Article 312A on changing service conditions of certain officers, and removed Article 314.

29.h: Added entries 65 and 66 to the Ninth Schedule.

30.h: Replaced Article 133(1) on civil appeals from High Courts to the Supreme Court.

31.h: Changed the number of House of the People members in Article 81, and added to Article 330 on reserved seats.

32.h: Added Articles 371D and 371E for Andhra Pradesh, removed it from Article 371, and changed a Seventh Schedule entry.

33.h: Changed when the seats of MPs and MLAs fall vacant, in Articles 101 and 190.

34.h: Added entries 67 to 86 to the Ninth Schedule.

35.h: Added Article 2A making Sikkim an associate of the Union, and changed Articles 80 and 81 to match.

36.h: Added Article 371F with special provisions for Sikkim, and removed Article 2A and related wording in Articles 80 and 81.

38.h: Added clauses on Ordinances and Emergencies to Articles 123, 213, 239B, 352, 356, 359 and 360; most were removed in 1979.

39.h: Added Article 329A on elections of the Prime Minister and Speaker, replaced Article 71, and added Ninth Schedule entries 87 to 124.

40.h: Replaced Article 297 on resources in territorial waters and the continental shelf, and added Ninth Schedule entries 125 to 188.

41.h: Changed the retirement age of Public Service Commission members, replacing "sixty years" in Article 316.

42.h: Reworded the Preamble, added Articles 39A, 43A, 48A, extended House terms to six years, changed Emergency rules; its Article 31C change was struck down.

43.h: Removed Articles 31D, 32A, 131A, 144A, 226A and 228A, and related wording in Articles 145, 226, 228 and 366.

44.h: Removed the right to property (Article 31 and Article 19(1)(f)), changed Emergency grounds in Article 352, and replaced six-year House terms.

45.h: Extended the time limit for reserved seats and special representation in Article 334 from thirty to forty years.

46.h: Changed Union sales tax rules: amended Article 269, added clause (29A) to Article 366's definitions, and added Seventh Schedule entries.

47.h: Added entries 189 to 202 to the Ninth Schedule.

49.h: Changed Article 244 and the Fifth and Sixth Schedules on tribal areas, adding paragraph 12AA and other provisions to the Sixth Schedule.

50.h: Replaced Article 33 on Parliament's power to limit Fundamental Rights for the armed forces and similar forces.

51.h: Changed reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Articles 330 and 332.

52.h: Added the Tenth Schedule on disqualification for defection, and linked it to Articles 101, 102, 190 and 191.

53.h: Added Article 371G with special provisions for Mizoram.

54.h: Changed judges' salary provisions in Articles 125 and 221, and replaced salary figures in the Second Schedule.

55.h: Added Article 371H with special provisions for Arunachal Pradesh.

56.h: Added Article 371-I with special provisions for Goa.

57.h: Added to Article 332 on reserved Assembly seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

58.h: Added to Part XXII a provision for an authoritative text of the Constitution in Hindi.

59.h: Added Article 359A applying the Emergency Part to Punjab; it ceased to operate after two years.

60.h: Changed the limit on State taxes on professions and trades, replacing "two hundred and fifty rupees" in Article 276, and removed its proviso.

61.h: Lowered the minimum voting age in Article 326 from twenty-one to eighteen years.

62.h: Extended the time limit for reserved seats and special representation in Article 334 from forty to fifty years.

63.h: Removed Article 359A on Punjab and the proviso to Article 356 on President's Rule.

64.h: Added to Article 356 on President's Rule in States, including a proviso.

65.h: Replaced Article 338(1) and (2) on a National Commission for Scheduled Castes, and renumbered clause (3) as clause (10).

66.h: Added entries 203 to 257 to the Ninth Schedule.

67.h: Changed Article 356 on President's Rule in States.

68.h: Changed Article 356 on President's Rule in States.

69.h: Added Articles 239AA and 239AB with special provisions for Delhi.

70.h: Added to Article 54 on electing the President and to Article 239AA on Delhi.

71.h: Added to the list of languages in the Eighth Schedule.

73.h: Added Part IX, The Panchayats, and the Eleventh Schedule on their powers, and added to Article 280 on the Finance Commission.

74.h: Added Part IXA, The Municipalities, and the Twelfth Schedule on their powers, and added to Article 280 on the Finance Commission.

75.h: Added to Article 323B on tribunals for other matters, and relettered its sub-clauses.

76.h: Added entry 257A to the Ninth Schedule.

77.h: Added to Article 16 on equality of opportunity in public employment.

78.h: Added entries 258 to 284 to the Ninth Schedule.

79.h: Extended the time limit for reserved seats and special representation in Article 334 from fifty to sixty years.

80.h: Changed how Union taxes are shared with States: replaced Article 270 and parts of Article 269, and removed Article 272.

81.h: Added to Article 16 on equality of opportunity in public employment.

82.h: Added to Article 335 on the claims of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to public jobs.

83.h: Added to Article 243M, which lists areas where the Panchayats Part does not apply.

84.h: Replaced the year "2000" and related wording on seat readjustment in Articles 55, 81, 82, 170, 330 and 332.

85.h: Replaced certain words in Article 16 on public employment, with retrospective effect.

86.h: Added Article 21A, the right to free and compulsory education for children aged six to fourteen, replaced Article 45, and added a Fundamental Duty in Article 51A.

87.h: Replaced "1991" as the census year for seat readjustment in Articles 81, 82, 170 and 330.

88.h: Added Article 268A on service tax and a Seventh Schedule entry (92C), but these were never brought into force.

89.h: Added Article 338A, a National Commission for Scheduled Tribes, and limited Article 338 to Scheduled Castes.

90.h: Added to Article 332 on reserved Assembly seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

91.h: Added limits on Ministers to Articles 75 and 164, added Article 361B on paid political posts, and removed Tenth Schedule paragraph 3.

92.h: Added languages to the Eighth Schedule and renumbered its entries to fit them in.

93.h: Added to Article 15 on prohibiting discrimination.

94.h: Changed the States named in Article 164 on Ministers, replacing "Bihar".

95.h: Extended the time limit for reserved seats and special representation in Article 334 from sixty to seventy years.

96.h: Replaced "Oriya" in the Eighth Schedule list of languages.

97.h: Added Part IXB, The Co-operative Societies, and Article 43B on promoting them, and added to Article 19.

98.h: Added Article 371J with special provisions for Karnataka.

99.h: Added Article 124A, a National Judicial Appointments Commission, and changed how judges are appointed; the Supreme Court struck all of it down.

100.h: Added to the First Schedule, which lists the States and Union territories and their areas.

101.h: Added the Goods and Services Tax: new Articles 246A, 269A and 279A (GST Council), with changes to tax Articles and the Seventh Schedule.

102.h: Added Article 338B, a National Commission for Backward Classes, and Article 342A on socially and educationally backward classes.

103.h: Added to Articles 15 and 16, on non-discrimination and equal opportunity in public employment.

104.h: Extended the time limit for reserved seats in Article 334 from seventy to eighty years, and replaced its heading.

105.h: Added to Articles 338B and 342A, and changed the definition in Article 366(26C), on socially and educationally backward classes.

106.h: Added Articles 330A, 332A and 334A reserving seats for women in the House of the People and State Assemblies, and added to Article 239AA.
